aggregates.subject: markers
aggregates.note: Two drawn markers at one station because C12 establishes the item appears on both the state and the federal halves. The count is of appearances in the document, not of objects in the world.

2027 is the calendar year the priorities are addressed to, not a count of anything. The detector reads any numeral before a plural noun as a count, and this is the one place in the deck where that reading is wrong.
